commits: feat(daemon): name LEGION_GRANT_FILE and the static gh environment on every pane; install the gh shim at startup
fix(cli): read the grant from LEGION_GRANT_FILE ahead of LEGION_GRANT
fix(pi-envoy): write each bash command's grant to LEGION_GRANT_FILE instead of the tool env
test(pi-envoy): grant rig loads the production plugin tree and scores the grant file per command
docs: LEGION_GRANT_FILE delivery - why the bash tool env was abandoned, what the pane carries
docs: record the LEGION-54 pull request number
deviations: Plan 1d named the pane-env method `credentialPaneEnvironment`; it is `credentialProcessEnvironment` because runtime.contract.test.ts ('ProcessManager's members carry no tmux vocabulary') forbids pane/window in ProcessManager identifiers. Same body, same call sites.

Not in the plan: `legion gh` now drops every `worker-bin` PATH entry before spawning `gh` (`pathWithoutWorkerBin` in worker-bin.ts, beside `workerBinDir`; test 'spawns the real gh, never the pane's worker-bin shim'). With worker-bin first on the pane's PATH for life and LEGION_GRANT_FILE correctly scrubbed from gh's child env by buildGitHubTokenEnv (stripDispatchEnv, plan 1e), the first branch rig run showed `legion gh -- --version` resolving `gh` to the shim, which re-entered `legion gh` under the scrubbed env ('LEGION_GRANT_FILE is missing'; D FAIL on call 29). On 1.17.x the same recursion silently redeemed twice: the 1.17.0 before run shows three /gh-token 200s for one `legion gh` call.

Rig: record-grant writes `<grant file contents> <mode> <LEGION_GRANT or ->` (a third field beyond plan 4a's two) so the 1.17.0 before run still shows what each text-delivered command ran under; the analyzer only scores the first two.
Rig: run.ts's 20-minute deadline is a cleared setTimeout instead of Bun.sleep — the pending sleep kept the process alive ~17 minutes after the report was printed, which blocks `hub wait`.

Rig: the long leg has 34 bash calls (record steps 20-28 instead of 20-26) so `legion credential get`, `legion gh -- --version`, and `legion handoff complete` are bash calls 30-34 — acceptance 2 says 'on the 30th or later command' and with plan 4b's 32-call numbering `legion gh` was call 29. The before runs used the earlier prompt (they produced 34 and 39 bash calls themselves).
The PR number was added to the two docs' related_issues in a sixth commit after `gh pr create` (it cannot be known before the PR exists); no history rewrite of pushed commits.
trickyParts: Boot prune seeding: `pruneSecretFiles()` now seeds `processSecretFiles` from every live-locator name (token and its -grant) rather than from the files found on disk, so a grant file the extension writes later in a pane's life is still reaped when the locator clears (test 'reaps a secret file inherited from a previous daemon process...' writes the grant file after the boot prune).
`liveSecretFiles` includes the grant name for launches in flight too (holdProcessSecret), so a persist during a launch never reaps a grant file the new pane is about to write.
Mint-then-write order in the hook (spec Errors table): a write failure wastes one 60 s grant and blocks the command naming the path; `LEGION_GRANT_FILE` unset blocks before minting.

The rig's production mode copies ~240 MB once (RIG_REFRESH_PLUGINS=1 re-copies); `npm pack` swaps a released build in place of the installed package; `branch` copies the checkout's dist/*.js over the installed dist/ and keeps the installed package.json.
discoveredComplexity: Pre-existing flake: processes.test.ts 'retires an older generation's launch as stale when a park-then-re-admit starts a newer one first' (with 'retires and retries a worker whose boot...' and 'ensureController retires a stuck controller pane...') fails ~1 in 4 runs when run together and passed 6/6 alone; reproduced on a read-only export of main@origin (2 pass 1 fail on the first of four runs). Timing-dependent retire/watchdog tests, not touched by this branch; if it fails in CI, `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --failed`. Making those clocks deterministic is a separate change outside this issue.

Environmental: the three `LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1` live-tmux tests fail identically on main and the branch from this worker pane (`tmux session ownership marker failed ... no such session` on the private test server; nested tmux + the box's tmux shim) and are skipped when the gate is unset. CI's `Test daemon` job on a clean runner is the authority.

Working in a 1.17.0 pane while fixing this: the model (this worker) emitted a second `export LEGION_GRANT=` block on several bash calls, 403ing `jj git push` twice; the push and `gh pr create` went through eval's `tool.bash` (command string built in code), the LEGION-29 workaround from the gotchas doc.
